name: AXM Sandbox
notes: Session 1 of the alpha slice: portable project folders with declared boundaries (W03.01, W03.06, W07.01, W07.02). Host pattern reused from Game Hub. No entities, no clock, no renderer yet — those are Sessions 2-3 and this module does not claim them.
long_goal: Shapeable sandbox engine per AXM-SBX master route. Every session must leave declared seats (bodies, cores, migration) open rather than hardcoding today's tech into the spine.
